The promotion path for a Customer Success Manager (CSM) at NovaOps follows the general promotion process outlined in the handbook, with specific evidence requirements tailored to the CSM role [making-a-career.md#Promotion Process]. 

Promotions happen twice a year, with proposals due in March for April 1 effective dates and in September for October 1 effective dates [making-a-career.md#Promotion Process]. 

To be eligible, you need at least six months in your current role, sustained performance, and evidence that you are operating at the next level [making-a-career.md#Promotion Process]. 

Your manager will compile a promotion packet with this evidence, peer input when relevant, and map it to the next title level. The packet will then go through calibration with People Operations and department leadership before any promotion decision is made [making-a-career.md#Promotion Process].
